test_cases.name: Verbose quote request from unknown sender with non-catalog item
test_cases.description: A verbose, detailed quote request is sent from an unknown sender email, including both catalog and non-catalog items, triggering an intervention due to the unresolved customer identity and an unresolvable product reference.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote: Playlandia Mat and Deluxe Play Tunnel
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am reaching out to request a formal quote for a few items we are considering for our upcoming community event. I am coordinating procurement for a new initiative, and while we have not ordered from your company before, we have heard positive feedback from other organizations in our network. Please include the following in your quote:

- 2 units of the Playlandia Colorful Play Mat (this is for our toddler activity area, so please confirm if there are any bulk discounts for this item).
- 1 Deluxe Play Tunnel (we saw this referenced in a recent event catalog, but I do not see it listed on your website—please advise if this is available or if there is a comparable alternative).

If you require any additional information regarding our organization or need to set up a new customer profile, please let me know what details are needed. We are aiming to finalize our order within the next week, so a prompt response would be greatly appreciated.

Best regards,
Unknown Sender 12

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request from unknown sender with intervention-triggering item
test_cases.description: A verbose, polite quote request sent by an unknown sender, including both catalog items and at least one item that cannot be mapped to the available catalog, thereby triggering intervention for customer resolution.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quotation – Multiple Items
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. My name is Unknown Sender 15, and I am reaching out on behalf of our procurement department, although I realize you may not have my details on file yet. We are currently evaluating suppliers for an upcoming project and would appreciate your assistance with a quotation for several items.

Specifically, we are interested in the following:

- 10 units of the Rasta Drip Coffee Maker
- 20 sets of AdventureCraft Building Blocks
- 15 units of the WonderWash Washing Machine
- 12 packs of Premium Office Paper (A4, 80gsm)

The first three items are intended for our staff lounge and team-building activities, while the office paper is for general administrative use. Please include pricing, availability, and estimated delivery timelines for each item. If you require any additional information or documentation to process this request, kindly let me know.

Best regards,
Unknown Sender 15

test_cases.name: Verbose unknown sender quote request with intervention-triggering item

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request – Some Toys and Accessories
initial_turn.body:
Hi there,

I hope this email finds you well! I’m reaching out because I’d like to get a quote for a few items for our upcoming event. I’m not sure if you need any extra info about our company, but I’m happy to provide whatever you need – just let me know.

Here’s what I’m looking for:
- 2 sets of SmartToys Building Blocks
- 1 Playlandia Colorful Play Mat
- 1 WonderWagon Deluxe Train Set (I saw something similar at a friend’s place, but not sure if you carry this exact model)
- 3 T-Shirts (any style, preferably with fun designs)

If you need more details or clarification on any of the items, just ask. I’m not sure if the train set is part of your catalog, but I’d love to know if you have something comparable. Also, please let me know if you need any company info or registration details from me to process the quote.

Best regards,
Unknown Sender 6
